entries.10df3122b06dd300: It develops and manufactures electronic components and related products, and sells them to customers and sales companies in Japan and overseas. The flow is that Murata Manufacturing Co., Ltd. itself produces semi-finished products, which are intermediate products of electronic components, and supplies them to production companies in Japan and overseas; the production companies process them into finished products and deliver them to Murata Manufacturing Co., Ltd. or its sales companies, which then sell them to customers. The components do not reach consumers on their own; they are used built into devices such as smartphones, servers, automobiles and game consoles. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, there was no counterparty accounting for 10% or more of revenue.
